school.elementalarcana.fire.desc: Raw, burning power. Strikes hard and leaves enemies ablaze.
school.elementalarcana.water.desc: Flowing and restorative. Pushes foes away and mends allies.
school.elementalarcana.ice.desc: Cold and precise. Slows, freezes and controls the battlefield.
school.elementalarcana.wind.desc: Swift and free. Rides the air and scatters anything close.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.desc: Hold to grow a fireball in your palm, release to throw it. It explodes where it lands, igniting everything nearby. Melts frozen enemies and Vaporizes wet ones for extra damage.
spell.elementalarcana.flame_burst.desc: A ring of fire erupts around you, burning everything close.
spell.elementalarcana.tidal_wave.desc: A wave that pushes enemies back and puts out fires.
spell.elementalarcana.healing_rain.desc: A soothing shower that regenerates you and nearby players.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.desc: Hold to form an icicle that grows sharper, release to launch it. Full charge freezes the target.
spell.elementalarcana.frost_nova.desc: Flash-freezes everything around you in place.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.desc: Ride the wind forward. Your landing is soft.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.desc: A column of wind throws you and nearby foes skyward.
message.elementalarcana.not_awakened: Your magic has not awakened yet
message.elementalarcana.overcast: You overcast, paying with your life force!
message.elementalarcana.new_affinity_slo: A new affinity can be awakened! Press %s to open your Status.
hud.elementalarcana.not_awakened: Your magic sleeps. Press %s to awaken it.
screen.elementalarcana.wheel.hint: Point at a spell, release %s to choose
screen.elementalarcana.awakening.subtitl: Choose the element your magic answers to. This choice is permanent.
Your power has grown. Choose another element to awaken.
message.elementalarcana.dev_no_permissio: The dev menu needs cheats enabled or operator permission
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.1.desc: Hold to form an icicle, release to launch it. A full charge freezes the target.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.2.desc: Two icicles form, one over each shoulder, and fly together.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.3.desc: Icicles charge in 0.75s, and even a quick tap-throw hits harder.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.4.desc: Three icicles form a crescent above you.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.5.desc: Choose a path: Piercing Cold or Shatterburst.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.6.desc: +25% damage, and full-charge freezes last longer.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.7.desc: Icicles curve toward the enemy nearest your crosshair.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.8.desc: Five icicles form an arc and fire in a rapid ripple.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.9.desc: Three hits from one volley freeze an enemy solid for 2 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.10.des: Choose a path: Glacial Lance or Endless Winter.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.pier: Icicles pass through up to 2 enemies and fly 30% faster.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.shat: Icicles explode on impact, hitting everything within 2 blocks for half damage.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.lanc: Keep holding after full charge: your icicles fuse into one giant lance that pierces everything.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.wint: Kills refund half the cooldown. Full-charge hits leave frost patches that slow enemies.

message.elementalarcana.branch_available: %s: a new path awaits. Open its skill tree to choose.

message.elementalarcana.respec.mana: Reforging your paths needs a full mana bar

screen.elementalarcana.detail.respec.hin: Reset this spell's paths so you can choose again. Uses all your mana; once per day.
screen.elementalarcana.detail.locked: You can't cast this spell yet
screen.elementalarcana.detail.need_maste: Cast this spell more to fill its mastery bar
screen.elementalarcana.detail.need_point: No skill points. Gain Magic Levels to earn more
screen.elementalarcana.detail.respec.con: Its chosen paths will be cleared so you can pick again. This drains all your mana and can only be done once per day.

spell.elementalarcana.frost_shield.desc: A shell of ice shards orbits you and absorbs damage, then shatters outward when it breaks.
Absorbs 6 damage for 8s. When it breaks it shatters, slowing enemies nearby.
Anything that strikes your shield in melee is slowed and frosted over.
Raise the shield just before a hit lands: a perfect block that throws back and freezes the attacker.
Choose a path: Mirror Frost or Frost Mantle.
Allies within 5 blocks also get a shield at half strength.
When your shield breaks, its shards explode and cut everything within 4 blocks.
The shield slowly regrows while up, and you're immune to fire and freezing.
An enemy that hits your shield three times is frozen solid.
Choose a path: Absolute Zero or Frozen Sanctuary.
spell.elementalarcana.frost_shield.branc: Arrows and other projectiles bounce off your shield, back at whoever fired them.
A thinner shield, but while it's up you gain armor, can't be knocked back, and your melee hits chill enemies.
Your shield becomes a dome: no projectile gets through, and enemies pushing in are thrown back and slowed.
A killing blow while shielded encases you in ice instead: invulnerable for 3s while you heal. Once every 5 minutes.
message.elementalarcana.frost_shield.san: Frozen Sanctuary: the ice saved you!
spell.elementalarcana.wind_blade.desc: Hold to gather a crescent of wind, release to slash toward your target. Wind hits Swirl other elements.
Hold to form a crescent of wind, release to throw it. Knockback grows with the charge.
Two crescents, fanned into a V.
Blades cut through one enemy, charge in 0.75s, and even quick taps hit harder.
Choose a path: Boomerang or Tempest Edge.
+25% damage, and a full charge launches targets Airborne (they take 25% more damage until they land).
Releasing your blades gives you a burst of speed.
Five crescents in a wide fan.
Blades deal double damage to Airborne enemies.
spell.elementalarcana.wind_blade.tier.10: Choose a path: Storm Scythe or Thousand Cuts.
Blades fly out, then turn and come back to you, cutting enemies again on the way.
Fully charged blades leave a small whirlwind where they land, pulling enemies together.
Keep holding after full charge: your blades merge into one giant crescent that cuts through everything in its path.
Every blade that hits splits into two smaller blades that seek out the nearest other enemies.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.1.de: Hold to grow a fireball, release to throw it. It bursts in a small explosion that sets things alight.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.2.de: The explosion grows to 2.5 blocks and burns longer.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.3.de: Fireballs charge in 0.75s, and even a quick tap-throw becomes a fast bolt that hits hard.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.4.de: Two fireballs, one over each hand.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.5.de: Choose a path: Cluster Bomb or Meteor.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.6.de: +25% damage, and burning enemies take a further +25%.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.7.de: Enemies that die while burning explode, setting everything around them alight. It can chain.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.8.de: A third fireball floats above your hands.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.9.de: Explosions leave burning ground for 3 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.10.d: Choose a path: Sunfire or Phoenix.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.branch.cl: The fireball bursts into 4 bouncing bomblets that go off one after another.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.branch.me: Fireballs are lobbed in a high arc and land in a huge explosion with strong knockback, leaving burning ground.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.branch.su: Keep holding after full charge: your fireballs fuse into a miniature sun that detonates in a blinding blast.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.branch.ph: Fireballs home in on the enemy nearest your crosshair and fly through it. A phoenix that kills flies on to one more target.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.desc: Hold to spray a pressurized stream of water: rapid hits that push enemies back and soak them. Puts out fires; soaked enemies Freeze under ice and Vaporize under fire.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.1.d: Hold to spray a 12-block stream for up to 2 seconds. It pushes enemies back and makes them Wet.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.2.d: The stream lasts 3 seconds and reaches 16 blocks.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.3.d: Where the stream lands, the spray hits and soaks everything within 1.5 blocks.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.4.d: An enemy soaked for a full second is marked. Your next hit on it bursts for bonus damage.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.5.d: Choose a path: Tidecutter or Torrent.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.6.d: +10% damage for every half second you keep spraying, up to +50%.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.7.d: The stream heals players it touches instead of hurting them.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.8.d: Aim down to ride your jet into the air. While spraying, you drift down gently.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.9.d: Wet lasts 10 seconds, and the stream slows what it hits.
Choose a path: Maelstrom or Tsunami Lance.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.branch.t: A thin cutting line: it passes through every enemy in its path for 60% more damage, without pushing them.
A wide fire-hose blast that shoves whole crowds back hard and turns lava into obsidian.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.branch.m: Spray for 2 seconds or more and, when you let go, the spot you hit becomes a whirlpool that drags enemies around for 4 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.branch.l: When you let go, the stream compresses into a giant water spear that pierces everything. The longer you sprayed, the stronger it is.
